$comment: Desired repository policy for every repository this account owns. Applied by .github/workflows/repository-policy.yml. A repository absent from `repositories` and matching no entry in `patterns` is reported, never touched: forks and scratch repositories are meant to stay as they are.

settings.$comment: Rebase is the only merge method, so the linear history the release tooling assumes cannot be broken by a stray squash. Push protection refuses a commit carrying a credential instead of reporting it once it is already public.

lovelace-card.$comment: A card has no manifest and no Python package, so hassfest and the version check are skipped rather than run.

patterns.$comment: A public, unarchived, non-fork repository whose name matches a glob gets that entry without being listed, so a new integration is protected from its first weekly run. An explicit entry in `repositories` always wins; `null` there opts a matching repository out.

ha-correios.$comment: Ships a Lovelace card next to the integration, so the card's syntax check is required on top of the profile.

transporte-sp.$comment: The dataset is regenerated from the sources, so a pull request must be rebuilt against the branch it lands on.
